content.what_it_is: Comment-only placeholder in mod_subgrid.f90. Its copied prose describes TIDE_MODULE and tide/surge boundary conditions at L57, while its final comment says 'end subgrid' at L62. It defines no Fortran module, state, procedure, equation, call or I/O.

verbatim_spans.text: !  TIDE_MODULE is a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation

unresolved: The path/header identity and description are a copy/paste mismatch: mod_subgrid.f90 ends as subgrid at L62 but claims to be TIDE_MODULE at L57, and no module is defined. A build or reader cannot determine whether this unit is an unimplemented subgrid component or a duplicate tide placeholder.
